snow.detail: 6 AM – Awwww yeah. We're back! After months of daydreaming through searing summer heat, sweet snow-sliding has returned to the delight of your turn-starved feet. All systems are a go for day number one of the 2026/27 season here in Jackson Hole. One inch of new snow fell overnight, and frosty flakes continue to fly on the mountain. An active Winter Storm Warning is wasting no time welcoming us back onto our skis, with wild weather expected to continue until tomorrow afternoon. While the valley experiences a mix of precipitation types through the day, the slopes will be plastered with a fresh, effective pow layer. Gusty west winds cranking in the 10-30 mph range will help smooth out the nooks and crannies. Look for high temperatures to top out in the upper 20s on Apres Vous Mountain and around 40 down in the Villy. You've waited so long for this day to come. So, don't succumb to trappings of the Black-Friday consumer craze. It's time to get lost in the magic of a big-mountain white vapor haze. -Lege
snow.inversionMessage: INVERSION ALERT! The Upper Mountain is warmer than the base. Head up high to stay warm.
